scenes.title: 1991 Pomona Pocket-Diary Test & 30-Second Stopwatch Trap: Straining Deepens the Word Freeze

layout.description: Sunlit psychology testing room where a 54-year-old adult sits across a walnut table from Deborah Burke beside an open 4-Week Word-Block Diary, a stack of celebrity/acquaintance cue cards, and a 30-second red-zone stopwatch.

positions.who: 54-year-old adult participant in smart linen blazer and collared shirt
positions.where: leaning forward over the walnut table snapping fingers beside an open pocket diary as a familiar name stalls mid-air
positions.facing: facing researcher across the cue-card desk

positions.who: Deborah Burke in tailored academic cardigan and glasses
positions.where: seated across the walnut table flipping a cue card and clicking a 10s-vs-30s stopwatch

props.name: leather-bound 4-Week Tip-of-the-Tongue Diary and brass pen
props.period_detail: 1991 structured daily log recording First Letter, Syllables, and Blocker Words
props.physical_behavior: State-A participant taps brass pen rapidly beside blank Name line -> State-B writes initial letter 'M___ (3 syllables)' in sudden recognition

props.name: split 10-Second vs 30-Second lab stopwatch and flipped answer card
props.period_detail: chronograph staging Warriner & Humphreys' 2008 10s-vs-30s error-learning delay
props.physical_behavior: State-A stopwatch sweeps past 30 seconds while participant strains -> State-B researcher flips answer card face-up to break the retrieval stall

actions.verb_sequence: points emphatically at a familiar portrait card knowing every biographical detail -> snaps fingers twice as the last name stalls -> writes the exact first letter in the diary -> exhales when the card flips
tracks the 30-second straining window -> flips the target name card face-up

reactions.reaction: slaps palm lightly to forehead shouting 'Right! I knew it started with M!'
notes intact semantic memory paired with a temporary sound-bridge bottleneck

scenes.wardrobe: Tailored navy linen blazer over cream button-down; researcher in warm burgundy cardigan.
scenes.recognition_hook: You know their face, their job, and even the first letter of their name — yet straining for thirty seconds quietly trains your brain to freeze on that exact name again!

key_visual.description: a sunlit psychology lab where a 54-year-old adult snaps fingers over an open 4-Week Word-Block Diary beside a 30-second stopwatch as a researcher flips a portrait name card

scenes.title: Outdoor Backyard Patio Gathering: The Mid-Introduction Neighbor Name Freeze
scenes.era: Modern sunlit suburban backyard patio cookout (Outdoor)

layout.description: Warm golden-hour outdoor garden patio with string lights where a 52-year-old host turns with two iced drinks to introduce an old neighbor — and freezes mid-gesture.

positions.who: 52-year-old host and smiling neighbor on outdoor patio
positions.where: standing beside a patio table under garden trees as the host gestures mid-introduction
positions.facing: facing each other on the sunlit patio

props.name: two condensation-beaded iced-tea glasses on teak patio table
props.physical_behavior: State-A host lifts glass smoothly to introduce friend -> State-B hand freezes mid-air as name vanishes

actions.verb_sequence: lifts glass to make a warm introduction -> freezes mid-syllable with hand open in air

reactions.reaction: gives a self-deprecating grin every adult over 40 recognizes instantly

scenes.wardrobe: Crisp rolled-sleeve chambray shirt and chinos.
scenes.recognition_hook: Every detail of how you know them is crystal-clear — except the one arbitrary proper-name sound tag.

scenes.title: 10-Second Phone Lookup Cure: Repairing the Sound Wire Immediately

layout.description: Bright home kitchen counter where a 52-year-old adult stops straining after 10 seconds, checks the name quickly on a phone screen, and speaks the name aloud while pouring coffee.

positions.where: glancing briefly at phone screen beside a ceramic coffee carafe and speaking the recovered name aloud

props.name: smartphone displaying recovered name beside ceramic coffee mug
props.physical_behavior: State-A thumb taps quick 10-second lookup -> State-B sets phone face-down and speaks name cleanly aloud

actions.verb_sequence: stops grinding after 10 seconds -> checks name once and repeats it aloud in a full sentence

reactions.reaction: relaxes shoulders as the sound pathway resets cleanly

scenes.recognition_hook: Looking a stuck name up at 10 seconds and saying it out loud beats 30 seconds of stubborn straining.
